name: Zenterest stale price feed under-collateralised borrow
summary: ZenterestPriceFeed still served long-stale prices for the abandoned MPH and WHITE markets, so 21,200 MPH supplied as collateral supported borrowing the entire WHITE balance of the zenWHITE market, which the attacker walked away with.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history were imported from the seed inventory without independent review.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: the Zenterest Unitroller 0x606246e9EF6C70DCb6CEE42136cd06D127E2B7C7 reports oracle() == 0x47D748C9BAbD5cCa642F9f98e07442C0B5b04d2f at block 20541639; that feed (verified, ContractName ZenterestPriceFeed) was created 2021-01-21T08:46:09Z by 0x21ddf70bfb842e9eed59df7af411fc602d7eed4b, not the attack-tx sender 0x5d5acc816a41fb59b043bc1028425c9645c0c336, and has no EIP-1967 events, so its code has been unchanged for 1303 days. The PoC supplies MPH to zenMPH, donates flash-loaned WHITE into zenWHITE, accrues interest and borrows the whole WHITE market; the attacker did not move any price, so this is a stale-configuration defect rather than oracle manipulation. Reported profit ~21,000 USD.
